race.comment: PARTY BOSS (10) makes strong appeal after resuming with a determined Class 2 win at Leeton, where he beat Simone's Choice as odds-on favourite and drove hard late. The rise to 1300m is not a major concern given his one win and one placing from two attempts at the distance, and the weight relief strengthens his case. BRUTAL EYES (11) has been around the mark all campaign and her Canberra fourth in Open grade reads better with the wide-run excuse. Her record at this distance is a key asset. SERENADING (12) has won three from six overall and produced a powerful finish to win a Class 3 at this track last start, with her local record giving her clear upside again. CANNY HELL (1) was plain at Dubbo last start, but the Corowa BM82 second reads well enough. Include.
